Project Scope

Scope of Work

A. Storefront & Patient Assessment
Page Description Pages
Homepage Product-focused introduction to RR online care with assessment and purchase calls to action. /home
Treatments Listing page and reusable treatment detail template covering benefits, process, FAQs and enquiries. /treatments /treatment-1
Hair Loss Issues Educational listing and reusable detail template linking concerns to relevant care options. /hair-loss-issues /hair-loss-issue-single
Products Catalogue and reusable product detail template with information, usage, pricing and purchase eligibility. /products /product-single
Case Studies & Testimonials Listing of patient experiences and before-and-after results in a consistent layout. /case-studies /testimonials
Assessment One predefined quiz shared across entry points, with health questions, photos, consent, submission status and additional information requests. Flow: assessment → registration → doctor review → prescription where appropriate → purchase. /assessment /assessment/status /assessment/additional-information
Patient Account Registration, login, password reset, profile, delivery address, order history, assessment status, prescription records and basic staff-entered clinic visit logs. /register /login /forgot-password /reset-password /account/profile /account/addresses /account/orders /account/order-single /account/assessments /account/prescriptions /account/clinic-visits
Cart & Checkout Cart, delivery details, basic shipping, one payment gateway, confirmation and server-side prescription eligibility checks. /cart /checkout /order-confirmation
Policy Pages Privacy, terms, shipping and refund pages using RR-supplied content. /privacy /terms /shipping /refund
B. Doctor & Admin Dashboard
Page Description Pages
Doctor Summary Counts of pending assessments, cases requiring information and completed reviews. /dashboard/summary
Assessment Review Review patient responses and photos, enter notes, request information and update review status: pending, more information required, approved or declined. /dashboard/assessments /dashboard/assessment-single
Prescription Management Create/view patient-linked prescriptions with products, instructions, doctor identity and validity; apply agreed quantity and repeat-purchase rules. /dashboard/prescriptions /dashboard/prescription-create /dashboard/prescription-single
Products & Orders Manage product details, images, prices, basic stock and prescription requirements; view orders/payment status and update fulfilment/tracking. /dashboard/products /dashboard/product-create /dashboard/product-edit /dashboard/orders /dashboard/order-single
Patients & Access Manage patient submissions, basic visit logs, user/staff accounts and role permissions within one shared dashboard. /dashboard/patients /dashboard/patient-single /dashboard/visit-logs /dashboard/users /dashboard/roles
